title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 142
description: Ten questions on Psalms 142: a cry for mercy, a hidden snare, and a soul brought out of prison.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh for with his voice?
questions.explanation: He says, "I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy."

questions.text: What does the psalmist pour out before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: He says, "I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles."

questions.text: What did Yahweh know when the psalmist's spirit was overwhelmed within him?
questions.explanation: He says that when his spirit was overwhelmed within him, God knew his route.

questions.text: What have they hidden on the path in which the psalmist walks?
questions.explanation: He says that on the path in which he walks, they have hidden a snare for him.

questions.text: What does the psalmist see when he looks on his right?
questions.explanation: He says, "Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me."

answers.text: There is no one who is concerned for him
An army of enemies surrounding him
A helper that God has sent to him

questions.text: What did the psalmist call Yahweh when he cried to him?
questions.explanation: He cried, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."

answers.text: His shepherd and his guide through the valley
His rock and his fortress in the day of battle
His refuge and his portion in the land of the living
His light and his salvation from all fear

questions.text: Why does the psalmist ask to be delivered from his persecutors?
questions.explanation: He asks for deliverance from his persecutors because they are too strong for him.

answers.text: They are too strong for him

questions.text: How does the psalmist describe his own condition when he asks Yahweh to listen?
questions.explanation: He says, "Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need."

answers.text: He is sick and near death
He is forgotten like the dead

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask to be brought out of, so that he may give thanks to God's name?
questions.explanation: He prays, "Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name."

questions.text: Who will surround the psalmist, because God will be good to him?
questions.explanation: He says the righteous will surround him, for God will be good to him.
